notes.content:
We got a new trailer (also visible in the store page)

[previewyoutube=mzGP9Itd1M8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][h2][i]The mushroom art contest winners are...[/i][/h2][/h3]
[h1][b]EVERYONE GOT IN![/b][/h1]
All mushrooms from the contest have been successfully implemented!
Some are a bit of a secret while others jam it out on the dance floor.
There are a total of about 650 custom mushrooms.

[h2]Custom world[/h2]
We are happy to announce that Everhood 2 has a full integration with steam workshop and is possible to create levels that will be accessible inside the game!

We are intending to support creators to be part of Everhood’s funky world as we believe it has the potential to become something extraordinary.

[h3]Socials[/h3]
Make sure to check out [url=https://x.com/EverhoodGame]X(twitter)[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/everhood.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url] for more Everhood news and make sure to WISHLIST if you haven't already!!
